metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Wonder Man
metas.description: Small-time actor Simon Williams struggles to reckon with his personal life while hiding his super-powers as he tries to land his dream role. Meanwhile, a shady government agent leverages a new friendship in order to save his own job.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2026 · Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair
metas.description: Malcolm and his daughter are drawn into the family's chaos when Hal and Lois demand his presence for their 40th wedding anniversary party.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2025 · Reminder
metas.description: Deniz, a reliable, famous architect, and Güneş, a phenomenal editor, who decided to separate six months ago while on their way to a wedding, are swept into a journey that will change their lives with a message that arrives on their phones on the evening of the day they met by chance. This new adventure will make them discover the missing pieces of their old relationship and remind them of love.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Win or Lose
metas.description: Follows a middle school softball team in the week leading up to their championship game, and each episode is told from the perspective of a different character.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2025 · The Eighth Family
metas.description: With their invention of bulletproof thermal underwear, the Basmacıgil Family earns the title of the Eighth Family, one of the ruling forces of the world. Yet, as six very different siblings attempt to run the family business, their well-meaning but ineffective efforts leave their father Erol convinced that “no outside enemy is necessary."

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2026 · Lucky Luke
metas.description: Lucky Luke must help Louise find her mother, who mysteriously disappeared, while foiling a plot that could change the course of American history.
